title: Quantifying Bias in Automatic Speech Recognition
reasoning: The paper's entire motivation is to uncover and quantify bias in an ASR system, which is framed as an ethical problem. The goal is to enable 'proactive bias mitigation' and 'responsible ASR system development'. The discussion explicitly states that ASR systems can 'perpetuate the existing bias in society' and suggests strategies to mitigate 'prejudice'. One of the authors is affiliated with an 'Ethics and Philosophy of Technology Section', underscoring the central role of ethics in the research, which goes beyond a mere 'Ethical Considerations' section.
